chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman in her late fifties, round face, wearing a mint-green velvet house djellaba with gold embroidered trim and a cream headscarf
chars.INLAW: a Moroccan woman in her early sixties, sharp face, thick black-rimmed glasses, wearing a deep burgundy djellaba and a black headscarf with a silver brooch, holding a black leather handbag
chars.SON: a Moroccan man in his early thirties, short black hair, short beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark jeans
chars.WIFE: a Moroccan young woman in her late twenties, wearing a lilac hijab and a long beige coat

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At the open front door of a Moroccan family apartment, MOM holds a tray with a bowl of milk and dates but has frozen mid-step, her welcoming smile gone, staring hard and suspiciously at INLAW who stands on the doorstep facing her. Seen from just behind INLAW's shoulder in the stairwell, head-to-waist framing, MOM's face clearly visible and centered, calm background at edges. Flat 2D animated illustration style, warm hallway light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Evening on a quiet street in a Moroccan city neighborhood, SON and WIFE walk toward a residential building entrance; WIFE smiles happily, SON looks back over his shoulder with an uneasy, regretful expression. Head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, subjects centered, calm background at edges. Flat 2D animated illustration style, golden dusk light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: INLAW steps out of a small beige Moroccan petit taxi on the street, WIFE hugging her warmly and taking her handbag; INLAW looks up at the building with a cold unreadable expression. Head-to-waist framing, faces visible, subjects centered, calm background at edges. Flat 2D animated illustration style, dusk light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the entrance of a Moroccan family apartment, MOM beams with joy holding a tray with a bowl of milk and a plate of dates, raising her other hand in welcome; SON smiles at her in the doorway. Patterned zellige tiles and a low wooden console in the background. Head-to-waist framing, faces visible, subjects centered. Flat 2D animated illustration style, warm light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan salon with long banquette sofas, MOM and INLAW stand face to face a step apart, both staring at each other with narrowed suspicious eyes, frozen tension, a tea tray untouched on the low table between them. Seen from the salon doorway, head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, subjects centered, calm background at edges. Flat 2D animated illustration style, warm lamp light.
